0.content:
Kano Nana is a shrine maiden of the Grand Narukami Shrine who also has a hand in Shuumatsuban affairs, checking Sayu's orders and training. Ayaka assigned her to supervise Sayu, and her job is to find Sayu and drag her to ninjutsu training in Chinju Forest. She has uncanny intuition and knows most of Sayu's napping spots, and turns discovered spots into training grounds. Sayu calls her "the bane of my existence", yet Nana defends Sayu as loyal and never one to break the organisation's principles. She is a novel lover and a favourite of Yae Miko.

She gives Sayu a carrot cake and a day off every birthday, commissions carrots so Sayu will eat vegetables, and complains to Yae that hunting Sayu leaves her no time to read. Yae suspects Sayu has a secret ally helping her hide, and sometimes misdirects Nana herself. Nana is Shikanoin Heizou's distant cousin.

1.content:
For as long as Sayu can remember she trained with her sensei in the Shuumatsuban. When she hit a plateau, the sensei decided that a ninja should not rely on others too much and, once she could defend herself, left quietly. Sayu remembers them as strong, responsible and kind; they never pushed her to work more. She does not know their name, is not sure they were a ninja, and only knows they were taller than her. They said they had "important matters" to attend to and hoped she would become a ninja everyone can trust.

The sensei gave her the Mini Mujina outfit and asked Ayaka to watch over her. They marked her height with a rope on a tree in Chinju Forest and told her that nothing is more satisfying than growing. In the hangout, the Traveler suggests the tree means she too will one day give shelter. Sayu decides that once she has grown she will protect someone with her ninjutsu, and that the Traveler reminds her of her sensei. Status unknown; never invent a return or identity.

2.content:
Yoohoo Art (in Japanese "Oko-ryuu", from an interjection like "alas") is a school of ninjutsu famed for mocking its enemies. Sayu is its last successor and learned only escape, clone and concealment techniques, which look beautiful (a silhouette vanishes in falling leaves and a kite lies where she stood) but do little in combat. She finds the name embarrassing. Her Fuufuu Windwheel was invented for running away; with a Vision she now also rolls over foes with it. The Muji-Muji Daruma is a small helper that heals or attacks for her.

Kano Nana calls the windwheel an agility exercise; Sayu "teaches" it by telling people to wiggle and turn into a ball. Gameplay: Elemental Skill Yoohoo Art: Fuuin Dash, Burst Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry, passives that heal on Swirl, and a utility passive that keeps wildlife from being startled.

3.content:
The Shuumatsuban is a secret ninja organisation under the Yashiro Commission, answering to the head of the Kamisato Clan, now Kamisato Ayato. Its work is espionage, intelligence and matters "inconvenient" to the higher-ups, sometimes including ambushes. Most members are orphans taken in and raised young, which secures their loyalty. Sayu is its "resident ninja" and has been raised in it since childhood. By her own account she is only given information gathering and stealing; Ogawa notes she never took confrontational jobs such as ambushes. Orders and reports pass through a clerk and a mission box.

Members are paid monthly. The organisation has its own Ninken (ninja dogs) and, since 6.2, a demanding inspector, Sumire, and new training pushed by officials returning from a war-game simulation. Other known ninja include Momoyo and the Ninken Gaumaru.

4.comment: Sayu: The Mujina, not a tanuki
4.content: A mujina is an animal like a tanuki but, Sayu insists, "way cuter"; she promises to show the Traveler one. Her outfit was styled after it, but almost everyone takes her for a tanuki, so she now holds a grudge against tanuki. At first she would explain patiently, "I'm not a tanuki, I'm Sayu"; now she pouts or, in Itto's case, attacks. She likes the Serenitea Pot because "there are no wild tanuki here". In 5.4 a tanuki youkai, Kichiboushi, wondered whether she was a shapeshifting youkai; she protested she has been human the whole time.

5.comment: Sayu: Proof of Guilt (Vision Hunt Decree)
5.content: While the Traveler was a fugitive, Yae Miko needed evidence that the Tenryou Commission had betrayed the Shogun. She produced "the most chronically lazy member" of the Shuumatsuban: a toy tanuki in Chinju Forest that turned into a snoring Sayu. At Komore Teahouse, Ayaka and Thoma planned the raid: Yoimiya's firework set off near the Statue of the Omnipresent God would distract the guards while Sayu slipped into the Tenryou Commission. She asked to be rescued if caught. She came back dizzy and panting, said this was too much exercise even for growth, and handed over a bundle of suspicious documents. Among them were a sealed official report the Tenryou Commission was preparing for the Shogun and correspondence with the Fatui, evidence that helped bring down the Decree. Then she went to sleep.

6.content:
Sayu can hide from almost anyone except Yae Miko: clones and aura concealment do not fool her, and running would risk angering her. Yae constantly pats Sayu's head. Sayu has never bitten her or protested out of fear, but worries she will be stuck at this height forever. Yae calls her "the little ninja child", and sometimes helps her steal nap time; Sayu once told her afternoon sunshine is the most pleasant, which inspired Yae's own days out in disguise.

Yae recruited Sayu for the Traveler in 2.1, picked her as Sara's statue buyer in 2.6 (limited), and in Sayu's 2023 letter decided to keep ornamental fish, which Sayu volunteered to catch so she could skip practice.

7.content: Soon after her sensei left, a minor mission went wrong in a time of unrest. Surrounded by strong enemies, Sayu got the intelligence out at great cost. Wounded and close to fainting, she thought that brute force does not decide everything: the weak notice the unseen moments that change fate, and escape is what her ninjutsu is for. She vanished as the leaves fell. The next morning the ninja pack on her leg was gone, and a Vision gleamed in its place. It lets her swing a claymore taller than she is, but, she laments, it does nothing for her height.

8.comment: Sayu: Kamisato Ayaka and Kamisato Ayato
8.content: Ayaka calls her "little Sayu" and believes she has been lost since her sensei left; she asks the Traveler to report any slacking. In the hangout she tells Sayu that some missions only she can do, and privately explains that the sensei asked her to watch Sayu's progress. That promise is why Kano Nana follows her. Sayu answers that the Shuumatsuban would be the same without her, then leaves, overwhelmed. Ayato, her ultimate superior, says she looks idle but always gives indispensable help when it counts. He knows where she naps in the afternoon trees and can find her easily. Sayu, overhearing the shrine maidens, cannot understand why he does not just skip his work.

9.content: In Sayu's Hangout Event, she receives an order to ambush the Traveler, something never assigned to her before. She follows the Traveler only to check they are all right. One path reveals the truth. Ogawa, the clerk who passes orders to the Shuumatsuban, forged it because a Kairagi, Inou, kidnapped his daughter Kotomi; he chose Sayu precisely because she never finishes such jobs. Sayu fakes success with a bag of the Traveler's hair and clothes. When Inou refuses to free the girl, she swaps herself for Kotomi while the Traveler fights, and the Tenryou Commission arrests him. Kotomi calls her "Ms. Ninja", and she admits the crying child made it feel like her own problem.

10.content: Every time Yoimiya sees her she says, "Hey, little tanuki! Let's go hang out at the festival." Sayu objects on three counts: not a tanuki, no festivals, and the real aim is a ninjutsu show during the fireworks, which has nothing to do with Shuumatsuban work. Fireworks are "terrible for my sleep". Even so, Yoimiya's fireworks covered Sayu's raid in 2.1, and in 2026 Yoimiya wrote that Klee and Sayu brought the little witches to Naganohara for fireworks and games.

11.content: Itto once patted Sayu's head when she was not looking and called her a tanuki. Now she pounces on him every time she sees him. He finds this baffling, since "a tanuki's what she's going for". Sayu wants to know why he has to be so loud and how he got so tall. In 6.6 she warned the little witches to cover their heads around him: one noogie and you will never grow. In 4.6 (limited) she napped near Itto's festival stage disguised as a Daruma, under a sign asking guests not to touch it.

12.content: Thoma, who has a Vision of his own, keeps asking Sayu to teach him ninjutsu. She does not see why, says she barely gets enough sleep as it is, and now actively avoids him. Thoma calls her "stubborn Sayu" and wonders whether a student looking for a teacher is really so out of line.

13.content: Klee founded the Little Hexenzirkel as a children's version of her mother Alice's witch circle. Joining only takes Klee's invitation, and members get "introduction magic". Sayu became "little witch Sayu" with Yaoyao and Qiqi. In 6.6 (limited event Phantasmal Pals), the Shuumatsuban rewarded Sayu for a tough mission with time off and funds to invite friends. She met Klee at the dock, and the shrine maidens helped host them. The group looked after Popcorn, an imaginary-friend boar warped by a tired adult's nightmare. They helped the baku collect nightmare fragments and welcomed Prune, who had come to "hunt witches", as a member.

14.content: In 6.2 (limited event), a Shuumatsuban group led by the new inspector Sumire went to Dragonspine for training. In Mondstadt, Klee got curious about Sayu's tail, invited her to a camp, and there they met Yaoyao; hide-and-seek made them friends. Because Klee holds the title "Spark Knight", Sayu assumed she ranks with the Grand Master, and Sumire, respecting Klee, stopped pulling Sayu away to train. Sayu feels at ease with them and likes the extra snacks people give her when they assume she is their age. She decided Cider Lake bass must be good for growth because Klee's tall mother eats it.
